S83.01.needs: a signed-in account in Cloud mode
S83.01.note: The all-plans comparison is off in this build because nativePurchases is false in apps/mobile/src/features/billing/storePurchases.json, so the plans screen shows only the signed-in plan.
steps: Sign in, open the sidebar and tap Settings.
In the Account section, tap Subscription.
Tap What your plan includes.
Look at the card and its Includes list, and compare with Expected: only the signed-in plan is shown, not a side-by-side comparison of all plans.
S83.01.where: Settings > Account > Subscription > What your plan includes

S83.03.needs: a signed-in account and a build with purchases switched on
S83.03.note: Checkout controls exist in apps/mobile/src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx but are drawn only when nativePurchases is true in storePurchases.json, and FEATURES.billing is false in apps/mobile/lib/v1FeatureFlags.ts, so no checkout can be reached in this build.

S83.05.note: No proration text exists in apps/mobile (searched for prorat, pro-rat and unused time); the only unused-time wording is in apps/mobile/src/features/settings/cloud-account/deleteAccountConfirmation.ts, so the item's code line is stale.

S83.06.note: No tax or total-price text exists in apps/mobile (searched for tax); the only price line, The store shows the exact charge before you approve., is drawn only with purchases switched on.

S83.08.needs: an account on a free trial
S83.08.note: The wording Free trial ends ... then renews unless you cancel is drawn only in the purchase branch, which is off in this build.
steps: Sign in with an account on a free trial.
Open Settings, then Account, then Subscription.
Read the row Trial ends and note its date.
Compare with Expected: only the end date is shown; the trial length and the charge after the trial are not shown on this screen in this build.

S83.13.needs: a build with purchases switched on
S83.13.note: The Purchase verified confirmation in apps/mobile/src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx is drawn only when nativePurchases is true, so no paid-purchase confirmation can be reached in this build.

S83.14.needs: an account with a failed payment
S83.14.note: The summary shows the raw subscription status and Paid capabilities are unavailable., with no payment-specific wording.
steps: Sign in with an account whose payment has failed (past due or similar).
Open Settings, then Account, then Subscription.
Read the summary under Your plan and the row Current plan.
Tap Help with your plan and compare with Expected: no payment-failure message or fix link is shown on this screen in this build, and Help with your plan opens Support.

S83.23.needs: an account with a scheduled cancellation
steps: Sign in with an account whose paid plan is set to end at the period end.
Open Settings, then Account, then Subscription.
Find the row Access ends and read its date.
Compare with Expected: the date is shown; the cancellation itself is made on the web or in the store, not on this screen.

S83.24.needs: an account that has cancelled to end of term
S83.24.note: The sentence saying what you keep until the end of the term is drawn only in the purchase branch, which is off in this build.
steps: Sign in with an account that has cancelled to end of term.
Open Settings, then Account, then Subscription.
Read the summary under Your plan and the row Access ends.
Compare with Expected: the end date is shown, but the screen does not say what you keep or what happens after.

S83.25.needs: a build with purchases switched on
S83.25.note: The Restore purchases row in apps/mobile/src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx is drawn only when nativePurchases is true, so it is not reachable in this build.

S83.26.needs: an account billed by Apple or Google
S83.26.note: In this build the Billing row has no store link, unlike the link the item expects.
steps: Sign in with an account billed by Apple or Google.
Open Settings, then Account, then Subscription.
Find the row Billing and read its value Managed where you subscribed.
Compare with Expected: the value names no store and there is no link; the store manage link is drawn only when purchases are switched on.

S83.27.needs: a build with purchases switched on
S83.27.note: The Subscription managed elsewhere alert in apps/mobile/src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx opens only from an upgrade row, which is drawn only when nativePurchases is true, so no duplicate-subscription warning can be reached in this build.

S83.29.needs: an admin account in a team workspace
S83.29.note: Seats are taken through invitations and accepted members, and no separate seat-assignment control was found.
steps: Sign in as an admin of a team workspace.
Open Settings, then Account, then Workspace.
Find the section Seats and invitations and read the row Seats, for example 'X of Y used'.
Tap Invite by email, enter an address, and tap Send invitation.
Compare with Expected: the Seats count changes and the pending invitation is shown as holding a seat.
S83.29.where: Settings > Account > Workspace > Seats and invitations
